message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, so there are no checksum verifications, signed URLs, or authentication controls present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels and assigns unknown nodes a default value of 0, but there is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples before they are used.

No detected model integrity verification: Although the code mentions a 'demo' run type with an option to use pre-trained weights, there is no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source enforcement visible in the provided code slice when loading any serialized model or weights.

No detected label distribution validation: While the code uses stratified splits (tri_split, stratified_split) to preserve class balance, there is no explicit validation step that checks label distribution, detects class imbalance, or verifies the expected label set before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of any backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, gradient anomaly detection, or similar defenses anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/val/test split is created via Holdout, there is no isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: While jsonschema is imported and argparse is used for config parsing, there are no visible input shape/range checks, Pydantic validation, or explicit malformed-input rejection on the data flowing into the model at inference time.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for probability bounds, NaN values, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a GNN model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
